heading: An agency, built the way we'd want to hire one.
whyExists: Too much local business marketing gets sold as a package instead of built as a strategy — the same SEO checklist, the same templated website, the same generic ad campaign, regardless of what the business actually needs. Amplivate exists to do it differently: work built around the business in front of us, priced fairly, and reported on honestly.
mission: To give UK local businesses access to the kind of strategic, bespoke marketing usually reserved for companies with much bigger budgets — without the bloated retainers or the jargon.

values.title: Honesty over hype
values.text: No invented urgency, no inflated promises, no results we can't stand behind.

values.title: Fit over templates
values.text: A plan built for your business's actual market, not a package sold to everyone.

values.title: Access over hierarchy
values.text: You deal directly with the person doing the work.

whatMakesDifferent: Most agencies scale by adding account managers between you and the work. Amplivate is built to stay small on purpose — every client works directly with the person actually running their campaigns, writing their site, and managing their ads.
howWeHelp: Through the work that actually moves the needle for local businesses — search visibility, a Google Business Profile that converts, a website built to sell, and advertising managed properly — plus practical AI tools that handle repetitive follow-up so nothing falls through the cracks.
vision: As Amplivate grows, so does this: a client dashboard for real-time reporting, AI tools clients can manage themselves, and resources for local businesses trying to understand their own marketing. Added because it's useful, not because it looks impressive.
